en: Colorful graphic postcard with an orange and red gradient background. On the left, inside a black oval, there is a black silhouette of a wolf-like animal labeled "BÖFF". On the right, inside another black oval, there is a black silhouette of a bull labeled "PÖFF". At the top right, large comic-style white text reads "AHOI KÄRDLAST!". The design is bold and cartoonish, without any photographic elements.
